settings.heading: Description
settings.content:
Tough Nut is our unique hazelnut liquor crafted from authentic high-proof Moonshine spirit fused with the flavour of hazelnuts, smooth caramel and velvety nougat complemented by a dash of barrel-aged whiskey.

Perfect for a variety of recipes and cocktails, our Tough Nut is great to enjoy neat over ice or can be used to give a Moonshine twist on classic drinks like a 'White Russian' or a nut infused ‘Espresso Martini’.

Head over to our Tough Nut cocktails recipes for more inspiration.

Bottled in traditional Mason Jars, we promise a unique drinking experience. If you would like to discover more high quality liqueurs, have a look at our entire product range and become part of our Moonshine Gang to collect proof points and get unique benefits.

Curious? Simply order your hazelnut liquor today online and we will ship the product anywhere in mainland UK within a few working days.

settings.heading: Perfect Serve
settings.content:
Tough Nut Neat

  • 50ml Tough Nut
  • Ice Cubes

Add ice to a short glass, then fill with as much Tough Nut as desired.

You can find more recipes on our Cocktails-Blog.

settings.heading: Allergens
settings.content:
All of our Moonshines, unless indicated otherwise, are allergen free in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 and amendments. All of our products are suitable for vegans and those with a gluten intolerance.

All of our spirits are produced using wheat based alcohol. While the distillation process removes gluten from the final product, individuals with certain conditions (i.e coeliac disease) may wish to exercise caution prior to purchase.
